summary:
Fixed `wrap` to include the final remainder line and avoid infinite loop on leading spaces. The loop dropped the last chunk (`return lines`), so changed to `return lines + [text]` and changed `if end == -1` to `if end <= 0` so a space only at index 0 (or no space) breaks at `cols` instead of looping forever.

RESULT: FIXED
